label: Native S&D Design

spec.brief: Build a compact three-route Search & Destroy arena. Give both teams meaningful choices off spawn, keep the middle route fast but exposed, make A more enclosed than B, and avoid a single sightline that controls most rotations.

designPlan.summary: Create three distinct east-west routes: a sheltered north lane to enclosed A, a direct exposed mid lane with staggered anti-sightline cover, and a more open south lane to B with flexible approach angles.
layout: North/A route around z=-10: segmented enclosure and corner cover, with two usable entrances to the site.
Middle route around z=0: shortest path, intentionally broad and exposed, but broken by offset cover so it cannot dominate cross-map rotations.
South/B route around z=9: lighter cover and a more open objective footprint, offering wider retake and flank options.
Spawn exits remain open toward all three routes; transverse connectors near each half permit rotations without creating one universal sightline.
priorities: Preserve at least three navigable spawn-to-spawn route families.
Make A clearly more enclosed than B.
Block direct spawn-to-spawn vision and long sightlines across most rotations.
Keep every intentional opening at least 1.2 m wide.
Validate objective reachability, route diversity, timing, and line of sight with the deterministic evaluator and scripted playtest.

brief: Build a compact three-route Search & Destroy arena. Give both teams meaningful choices off spawn, keep the middle route fast but exposed, make A more enclosed than B, and avoid a single sightline that controls most rotations.
finishSummary: Completed a compact three-route Search & Destroy arena. Segmented north and south lane dividers create distinct A, mid, and B paths with wide rotation gaps; staggered mid occluders preserve the fastest route while eliminating direct spawn sightlines. A is enclosed by a multi-wall shell with controlled entries, while B remains open with a single rear backstop and broad approach options. Both sites and all spawns are valid and connected, all intentional clearances pass the 1.2 m requirement, traced A/B approaches are distinct, and the final seeded proxy shows meaningful site choices with near-equal attacker arrival times.

limitations: Scripted seeded proxy. Not human play, combat AI, or a balance oracle.
Standing ground nav only. No jump, crouch, slide, shoot, or damage.
Site choice is travel distance + spawn-anchor exposure + seeded jitter.
Exposure is the fraction of route cells with clear LOS from one or more opposing spawn anchors.
Route concentration is the max fraction of successful rollouts visiting one non-spawn cell.
First contact is the first clear eye-height LOS between the two runners. No firing.
Same seed and rollout count replay the same spawn/jitter sequence.
